text:
sam: heads-up: staging restore jobs getting intermittent kms.Decrypt AccessDenied against HSM CMKs (~3-7% failures).
lee: example log?
sam: ops-bot: [2026-03-22T09:12:22Z] restore-req 991 error: kms.Decrypt AccessDenied: principal arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/restore-agent not authorized to use key (kms:Decrypt) status 403 req=5f3c...
nina: we recently switched to issuing ephemeral grants via kms-proxy and reduced default TTL in canary last night.
lee: TTL was 60s -> 25s in canary to limit live grants. restores can queue; decrypt may happen after grant expiry.
oncall-sre: can reproduce in staging when introducing artificial delay between grant and decrypt.
sec-qa: classify: P2 (availability + potential DoS if attacker induces delays). Also check if any chain leads to plaintext leaked.
sam: found uploader retry path that writes decrypted snapshot metadata to /tmp before upload in an error branch. filing tracker.
ops-bot: [2026-03-22T09:28:10Z] ticket created: UPLOAD-TEMPFILE-451 assigned to nina
nina: repro snippet: 
```
TMPDIR=/tmp uploader --upload snapshot && false || cp /tmp/snapmeta-* /tmp/leaktest
```
shows plaintext persists on crash.
lee: short fixes: 1) bump proxy TTL back (90-120s) for restore key aliases; 2) patch uploader to use O_TMPFILE or unlink-on-close pattern.
sam: policy change: deny direct kms:Decrypt for uploader role in prod; enforce decrypt via kms-proxy with limited ephemeral grants.
prod-logger: audit schema suggestion: include grant_id, grant_issued_at, grant_ttl_s, proxy_request_id in KMS events to correlate failures. example: {"event":"kms_decrypt","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:...","principal":"restore-agent","result":"AccessDenied","grant_id":"g-abc","grant_issued_at":"2026-03-22T09:11:45Z","grant_ttl_s":"25","proxy_req":"p-321"}
oncall-sre: temporary mitigation approved: increase TTL to 120s for aliases alias/staging/restore and alias/prod/restore for 30m window. will run canary 100 decrypts.
lee: canary script (staging): for i in {1..100}; do aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://meta.enc --key-id arn:... || echo fail$i; sleep 0.25; done
ops-bot: [2026-03-22T09:58:30Z] canary result: 0 fails /100 after TTL bump
nina: next steps: PRs for tmpfile fix (backup/uploader), proxy TTL config revert (infra/proxy), audit schema (observability), and IAM deny-list for uploader role.
sec-qa: open legal notice for potential exposure from /tmp in staging; retention for these enhanced audit events should be 90d.
sam: runbook add: encops-runbooks -> "ephemeral-grant-decrypt-failure": include quick commands, audit queries, and RBAC checklist.
lee: longer term: restore-agent should implement transparent grant_renew when KMS returns AccessDenied with grant-expired, with backoff.
ops-bot: [2026-03-22T10:18:10Z] incident UPLOAD-TEMPFILE-451 status: mitigated (canary pass); follow-ups created.
sec-qa: milestone: close when tmpfile fix + audit fields + IAM allowlist merged and prod canary shows <0.1% fails.
sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
